description: Asks the live server whether the site's script is connected right now: the websites with a visitor, how many visitors, and which websites the owner is watching. Needs the site's owner key, the part after #wib= in the watch link create_site returned. Load a page that has the tag (a private window counts as a visitor) before calling it.

key.description: The owner key: the part after #wib= in the watch link create_site returned. Never write it into a file.

siteId.description: The siteId create_site returned (12 lowercase letters and digits).

name: check_live
title: Is the script connected right now?
